verdict.rationale: The axis applies: an online government service could plausibly offer scheduled or recurring actions. However, nothing in the pack documents user-configurable automations that run in the background. EFTPS and Payment Plan appear only as bare link titles with no scheduling details. MeF and IRIS A2A are credentialed system-to-system intake channels that a third party would have to build its own automation on top of; they are not background automations the product itself provides.
